nav.title: Navigation
export.title: Data export
export.subtitle: Export instance data (objects) as CSV, Excel, JSON or BMEcat/ETIM.
export.profile_hint: A profile carries the format, the fields, the languages, the options and the BMEcat block — not the source: that is chosen per run. Loading one fills the form, saving one stores the current settings.
export.profile_save_hint: The name is the profile's key and cannot be changed later; the configuration is stored as it is set right now.
export.profile_unavailable: {count} field(s) of the profile are not offered for the current source.
export.fields_hint: Choose the columns to export; multilingual attributes produce one column per language.
export.fields_scope_type: Only attributes allowed for the object type “{type}”.
export.fields_scope_all: All attributes — the chosen source does not fix an object type.
export.fields_none: No attributes are defined for this object type.
export.bmecat_hint: The document header and the mapping are fixed by the standard: either the ETIM BMEcat 2005 profile or the classic BMEcat 1.2 `ARTICLE` document. Every class feature of a classified product is transmitted.
export.bmecat_language_hint: One file per language (the standard's rule); the code is the BMEcat/ISO 639-2 spelling.
export.bmecat_pid_hint: Attribute whose value becomes SUPPLIER_PID (fallback: code, then sku). The schema limits it to 32 characters.
export.bmecat_validity_hint: The result is validated against the schema of the chosen version when it is available (2005: resources/etim, 1.2: resources/bmecat; override with BMECAT_XSD).
export.bmecat_text_values: {count} alphanumeric feature(s) written as raw text - an ETIM value code (EV…) is not available yet.
export.bmecat_nodes_without_code: {count} assigned taxonomy node(s) without a `code` - they cannot name a reference feature group, so products assigned to them only are skipped.
export.bmecat_format_hint: `2005` writes the ETIM profile (PRODUCT, feature system ETIM-x.y). `1.2` writes the classic ARTICLE file: one language per document, prices and order details are mandatory, and a base-product reference cannot be expressed in 1.2.
export.bmecat_variant_hint: The DTD and the XSD variant of 1.2 use different namespaces: a document satisfies only one of them. The DTD is the classic one, the XSD checks units and lengths more strictly.
export.bmecat_issues: {count} note(s) about content this version cannot express:
export.bmecat_transaction_hint: `Product data only` writes the price-less transaction T_NEW_PRODUCTDATA. `Catalogue delivery` writes T_NEW_CATALOG: the standard then requires order details, a price and a UDX block per product - a product without a price is skipped and reported.
export.bmecat_price_attribute_hint: Attribute whose value becomes PRICE_AMOUNT (e.g. net_price).
export.bmecat_unit_hint: BMEcat unit code (UN/ECE Rec 20), e.g. C62 = piece, MTR = metre, KGM = kilogram.
export.bmecat_unpriced: {count} product(s) skipped: no price in the catalogue transaction.
export.bmecat_systems_fallback: No classification standard is registered for these class nodes - the version comes from the export profile (fallback).
export.show_reference_hint: Also offer the reference data of an imported classification standard (e.g. the ETIM features `EF…`). They are not part of your own attribute set, so they stay hidden by default.
export.email_hint: When set (and SMTP is configured), the finished export is sent as an attachment.
export.fields_required: Please select at least one field.
export.queued_no_id: Could not determine the export job id.
export.schedule_hint: Run this export automatically on a cron schedule (admin). Results stay downloadable below.
export.schedule_admin_only: Only administrators can manage scheduled exports.
export.schedule_cron_hint: 6 fields, seconds first: sec min hour day month weekday (e.g. 0 0 3 * * * = daily at 03:00).
export.recent_delete_all_hint: This removes the run records. Archived files in object storage are not removed.
export_profiles.title: Export profiles
export_profiles.subtitle: Reusable export configurations: format, fields, languages, options and the BMEcat block. The wizard offers them for selection and can store the current settings.
export_profiles.parameters_hint: What `POST /exports` accepts, without `source`: `fields`, `locales`, `options` and `bmecat`. Unknown keys are rejected.
export_profiles.load_failed: Could not load the export profiles.
export_profiles.invalid_root: The parameters must be a JSON object.
import.title: Data import
import.subtitle: Import objects from a CSV/Excel file via column mapping, or a MEF JSON document.
import.upload_hint: Upload a CSV (.csv), Excel (.xlsx) or MEF JSON (.json) file; CSV/XLSX use the first row as the header.
import.parsed_mef: {file}: MEF document with {objects} objects and {references} references.
import.mef_hint: The document is imported as-is: objects are upserted by business key, object id or source reference.
import.match_by_id_hint: Meadow's MEF export writes the core object id into `id`: enable this to update those objects instead of creating duplicates. Without a match the object is created with `id` as its source reference.
import.no_file: Please upload a CSV/XLSX file first.
import.empty_sheet: The selected worksheet contains no data.
import.mapping_hint: Map each source column to a field, an attribute, or a language-specific attribute ("attribute [lang]"). Custom attribute names can be typed directly.
import.ai_suggest_hint: Describe the file in words; the suggestion fills the mapping and is checked against the file and the data model. Cell values never reach the model.
config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: Export and import the Meadow Configuration Format (MCF): the data model and reference data.
config.export_hint: Choose the sections to include and download the MCF as JSON.
config.import_hint: Paste an MCF JSON document or upload a file, then preview or apply it.
config.invalid_document: The document is not a valid JSON object.

attr_def.standard_code_hint: Binds this attribute to a classification standard's feature: class features with this code are filled from this attribute (export, completeness). Empty = no binding.
attr_def.field_reference_hint: Reference data stays hidden in the product form, the export selection and the bulk maintenance, so the standard does not bury your own attributes. Untick to adopt it into your own attribute set.
attr_def.computed_rule_hint: Business rule that computes this value. It is only needed for the automatic recompute of inherited values (the rule is found by this name) — other rules may fill a computed attribute too, so an empty selection is allowed.
attr_def.dependencies_hint: Documents which attributes the formula reads. The core stores and exports this list but does not evaluate it — the rule sees the whole object.
attr_def.ai_suggest_hint: Fills dependencies, inherited reads and the rule name — the script belongs to a rule (Business Rules).
attr_def.ai_rule_missing: Rule `{name}` does not exist yet — create it under Business Rules first.
attr_def.key_needs_text: A business key needs the data type Text.
attr_def.key_not_multilingual: A business key cannot be multilingual.
attr_def.inheritable_blocked_by_key: A business key is never inheritable.
attr_def.required_follows_applicable: Only object types this attribute applies to can be required.
attr_def.delete_in_use: "{name}" is used by objects. Remove the values as well?
attr_def.reference_hidden: {count} standard attributes hidden — the vocabulary of an imported classification standard.

saved_searches.subtitle: Store complex searches and materialize their results as refreshable collections.
saved_searches.query_invalid: The search query is not valid JSON.
saved_searches.refresh_confirm: Refresh this collection now? Its members will be recomputed.
saved_searches.add_members_hint: Paste object IDs (one per line, or comma-separated). Existing members are skipped.

search_form.show_reference: Standard data in the field list ({count})

search_form.fulltext_hint: Searches all attribute values (the full-text index covers the whole attribute object).
search_form.not_shown: Not shown in the form (kept unchanged): {names}
object_types.title: Object Types
object_types.subtitle: Manage the business object types of your catalogue – including the key and label attribute per type.
object_types.key_hint: A key is a unique + required attribute for this type (empty = no key).
object_types.taxonomy_hint: Objects of this type are categories/classification nodes: they can be assigned via a categorisation and carry tree counters.
object_types.standards_hint: Installed standards (reference data): their class nodes, features and feature definitions come from a standard package, are replaced when a newer version is installed and are not edited like your own attributes. The BMEcat export names the reference feature system from here.
relation_definitions.title: Relation Types
relation_definitions.subtitle: Manage the relation types (composition vs. aggregation) – including type restrictions and edge attributes.
relation_definitions.system_locked: System relation types cannot be deleted.
relation_definitions.kind_hint: Custom types are always aggregations (n:m); composition stays reserved for the system.
relation_definitions.role_collection_hin: Collection membership: only points at collections (belongs to the built-in types).
relation_definitions.role_category_hint: Categorisation: only points at categories; each type is a separate assignment in the form and offers its own bulk operation.
relation_definitions.role_link_hint: Plain association; source and target types are free.
